item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence using anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. No one knows how to control such a system. We need an international ban before someone builds it.

2. We are not calling for safer superintelligence. There is no known way to make it safe. With anything like today’s techniques, building superintelligence means human extinction. We must prevent anyone from doing it.

3. A race to build superintelligence is a race toward the death of everyone on Earth. We cannot regulate our way through a failed attempt after the fact. We need enforceable international limits that stop it from being built.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence using anything like today’s techniques, everyone on Earth will die. These systems are not being made safe; they are being made more capable, more autonomous, and harder to control. No company, laboratory, or government knows how to align a superintelligence with humanity’s survival, and trial and error is not an option when one failed attempt ends the world. That is why we are working toward an international ban on the development of superintelligence. We do not need voluntary promises, vague safeguards, or another race dressed up as progress. We need enforceable limits that prevent anyone, anywhere, from building it—before the first irreversible attempt is made.
